mapper.select: SELECT X.NEWS_ID AS "newsId" ,X.TITLE AS "title" ,X.LINK AS "link" ,X.PRESS AS "press" ,X.STOCK_NAME AS "stockName" ,TO_CHAR(X.PUB_DATE, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "pubAt" FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (N.TITLE) N.ID AS NEWS_ID ,N.TITLE ,N.LINK ,N.PRESS ,S.NAME AS STOCK_NAME ,N.PUB_DATE FROM T_NEWS N LEFT JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = N.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND N.CATEGORY <> 'SPORTS' AND N.PUB_DATE >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') - INTERVAL '1 hour' * #{hours} ORDER BY N.TITLE, N.PUB_DATE DESC ) X ORDER BY X.PUB_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT QUIZ_DATE AS "quizDate" ,QUESTIONS_JSON AS "questionsJson" FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ WHERE 1=1 AND QUIZ_DATE <= #{upTo} ORDER BY QUIZ_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ WHERE 1=1 AND QUIZ_DATE = #{quizDate}
SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS "players" ,ROUND(AVG(SCORE), 2) AS "avgScore" FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY WHERE 1=1 AND QUIZ_DATE = #{quizDate}
SELECT SCORE AS "score" ,COUNT(*)::INT AS "count" FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY WHERE 1=1 AND QUIZ_DATE = #{quizDate} GROUP BY SCORE

SELECT U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,SUM(P.SCORE)::INT AS "total" ,COUNT(*)::INT AS "days" FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY P JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = P.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND P.QUIZ_DATE >= #{from} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL GROUP BY P.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME ORDER BY SUM(P.SCORE) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(P.INS_DAY) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT QUIZ_DATE FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY QUIZ_DATE DESC LIMIT 60
